subject: executor: Fix index join hash produces redundant rows for left outer anti semi join type (#52908)
summary: Reviewed the executor change in `indexHashJoinInnerWorker.getMatchedOuterRows`: it now uses `JoinType.IsSemiJoin()` (planner/core) instead of checking only `SemiJoin`/`LeftOuterSemiJoin`, which correctly includes `AntiLeftOuterSemiJoin` and prevents emitting the same outer row multiple times when multiple inner rows match (root cause of redundant rows). Confirmed `IsSemiJoin()` covers `AntiLeftOuterSemiJoin` and that `antiLeftOuterSemiJoiner.tryToMatchOuters` marks matches as `outerRowMatched`, so the dedup gating works as intended. Added regression test (`TestIssue52902`) targets the problematic `NOT EXISTS`-in-expression pattern under forced index hash join. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in the touched executor behavior.
